newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ZCCM, Gecamines yet to meet on cobalt.
newsitem.headline: ZCCM, Gecamines yet to meet on cobalt.

text.p: Zambian cobalt and copper producer Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines Ltd (ZCCM) and its Zairean counterpart Gecamines were still planning to meet to discuss the cobalt market, a ZCCM official said on Wednesday.
ZCCM said on August 5 that the two companies were concerned about the instability in prices and present levels which were not in the interest of producers, consumers and traders.
The company said at the time it would meet with Gecamines in the following two weeks.
ZCCM spokesman Francis Musundo said the meeting with Gecamines had not been shelved and would take place at a later date.
"When they (ZCCM and Gecamines) are ready they will make the announcement. I know they announced about three weeks ago that the meeting will take place," Musundo said by telephone from Zambia.
ZCCM said when they announced the meeting, that the company was trying to get some stablity in the cobalt market.
London cobalt traders said the move could be an attempt at making a joint cobalt policy between the African producers.
Cobalt recently recovered from 23-month lows and the cobalt cathode price was last quoted in London at $23 a lb.
